declarations.name: formatToolValue
declarations.description: A value as the call shows it: text as it is, anything else as indented JSON.

One step an AI agent took with a tool, as a collapsible card: the tool's name and what it did on one line, its
state, and, when opened, the input it was called with and the output it returned. Like the steps in Claude and
ChatGPT, or the Tool element of the Vercel AI SDK.

`state` moves the card through `pending` (queued, or its input still streaming in), `running`, `success`, `error`
and `cancelled`, each with its own mark and a translatable word, so the colour is never the only signal. `input` and
`output` take any value, as a property or as JSON in the attribute: text shows as it is and anything else as indented
JSON, in a box that scrolls past `--c2-tool-call__code--max-height`. The `input` and `output` slots replace them with
richer content, such as a `c2-json-viewer` or rendered Markdown. A failed call shows `error-text` in place of the
output.

The card is a native `<details>`, so the header is a button that opens and closes it from the keyboard and a screen
reader hears its expanded state. Content in the `actions` slot sits under the header and stays visible while the card
is closed: the place for Approve and Deny when a call waits on the user.

cssProperties.description: Width of the card; the host is a block.
cssProperties.name: --c2-tool-call--width

cssProperties.description: Space between the marks and the texts in the header.
cssProperties.name: --c2-tool-call__header--gap

cssProperties.description: The tool's name is an identifier, so it is set in monospace.
cssProperties.name: --c2-tool-call__name--font-family

cssProperties.description: The check and the cross drawn on the filled success and error marks.
cssProperties.name: --c2-tool-call__status-mark--color

cssProperties.description: One turn of the running mark.
cssProperties.name: --c2-tool-call__status--animation-duration

cssProperties.description: Space between the input and the output.
cssProperties.name: --c2-tool-call__body--gap

cssProperties.description: Tallest an input or output box gets before it scrolls.
cssProperties.name: --c2-tool-call__code--max-height

cssParts.description: The clickable header row, a native `<summary>`.
cssParts.name: header

cssParts.description: Component-owned region in the header that holds the `description` slot; without assigned content it shows the `description` text as its fallback. It sets the colour and the single-line truncation the slotted text inherits.
cssParts.name: description

cssParts.description: The duration and the state's word.
cssParts.name: meta

cssParts.description: Component-owned row under the header that holds the `actions` slot. It has no fallback: the row is hidden until content is assigned, then lays the assigned controls out in a wrapping row.
cssParts.name: actions

cssParts.description: What opening the card reveals: the input and the output.
cssParts.name: body

cssParts.description: Component-owned region of the input or the output: its heading, then the `input` or `output` slot. Without assigned content the slot shows its fallback, the formatted value (or `error-text`) in the `code` box; assigned content takes that place under the heading.
cssParts.name: section

cssParts.description: The box a formatted input or output is shown in.
cssParts.name: code

slots.description: The tool's own icon, before its name.
slots.name: icon

slots.description: Replaces `description`, the one line on what the call did.
slots.name: description

slots.description: Controls under the header, visible while the card is closed, such as Approve and Deny.
slots.name: actions

members.name: name
members.description: The tool's name, such as `search_web`; shown in monospace.

members.name: description
members.description: One line on what the call did or is doing, such as "Searched the web for lit ssr".

members.name: state
members.description: Where the call is. Each state has its own mark and word.

members.name: input
members.description: What the tool was called with. Text shows as it is; anything else as indented JSON. JSON in the attribute is parsed.

members.name: output
members.description: What the tool returned, shown like `input`.

members.name: errorText
members.description: The failure shown in place of the output while `state` is `error`.

members.name: duration
members.description: How long the call took, in milliseconds. Shown in the header when set.

members.name: open
members.description: Whether the card is open, showing the input and the output.

members.name: markScrollable
members.description: A box that scrolls has to be reachable from the keyboard to be read; one that does not is left out of the tab order.

events.description: Re-dispatched from the native details after the card opens or closes (`newState` is `open` or `closed`).
events.name: toggle
